lines.zh: 蓝色的环碾过草叶，草没有弯。
lines.en: My blue ring rolls over the grass without bending it.

lines.zh: 我不用脚，靠一声轻响往前挪。
lines.en: No feet. I move on the push of a soft note.

lines.zh: 石壁把我的光弹回来，我跟上去。
lines.en: The cave wall bounces my light back and I follow.

lines.zh: 宽得像一扇门，却轻得像一口气。
lines.en: Wide as a doorway, light as a single breath.

lines.zh: 每走一步，脚下的回声就晚半拍。
lines.en: Each step, my echo arrives half a beat late.

lines.zh: 我飘过蕨叶，露水都没抖落。
lines.en: I drift past ferns without shaking off a drop.

lines.zh: 水面上，我的倒影比我先到对岸。
lines.en: On water, my reflection reaches the far bank first.

lines.zh: 蓝色的边沿一收一放，像在呼吸。
lines.en: My blue rim tightens and loosens like breathing.

lines.zh: 走廊里我滚得很慢，光在墙上转。
lines.en: I roll slowly down the hall, light turning on the walls.

lines.zh: 雪地上没有脚印，只有一圈蓝。
lines.en: No footprints in the snow, just a ring of blue.

lines.zh: 我经过的地方，回声都变亮了一点。
lines.en: Everywhere I pass, the echoes come back brighter.

lines.zh: 从这头到那头，我用了整整一首歌。
lines.en: Crossing this room took me one whole song.

lines.zh: 别踩我的边，那里正在振动。
lines.en: Don't step on my rim, it is busy vibrating.

lines.zh: 大是小的一圈圈放大，我就是那圈大的。
lines.en: The large is the small, widened. I am that width.

lines.zh: 我从石阶上一层层降下去，很慢。
lines.en: I descend the steps one by one, slowly.

lines.zh: 两圈蓝光叠在一起，我变厚了一点。
lines.en: Two rings of blue overlap, and I grow a little thicker.

lines.zh: 我在等洞顶那滴水再落一次。
lines.en: I am waiting for the drip above to fall again.

lines.zh: 把刚才那声鸟叫再放一遍。
lines.en: Let me play that bird call back once more.

lines.zh: 安静太响了，我把它收小一点。
lines.en: The quiet is too loud. I am turning it down.

lines.zh: 我的环慢慢收拢，又慢慢张开。
lines.en: My ring closes slowly, then opens again.

lines.zh: 石头里的回声睡着了，我不吵它。
lines.en: The echo in the stone is asleep. I won't wake it.

lines.zh: 数到七，还是没有人回答。
lines.en: I counted to seven. Still no answer.

lines.zh: 我在听自己的余音什么时候停。
lines.en: I listen for when my own aftertone stops.

lines.zh: 一圈蓝光落在苔上，苔是暖的。
lines.en: A ring of blue rests on moss. The moss is warm.

lines.zh: 没有嘴，可我还是想哼点什么。
lines.en: No mouth, yet I still want to hum something.

lines.zh: 风穿过我，带走一半的音。
lines.en: Wind passes through me and takes half the note.

lines.zh: 我把自己叠成两层，又摊平。
lines.en: I fold myself into two layers, then flatten out.

lines.zh: 这里的回声比昨天短了一寸。
lines.en: The echo here is an inch shorter than yesterday.

lines.zh: 谁在很远的地方敲石头？我记下了。
lines.en: Someone knocks stone far away. I noted it.

lines.zh: 我亮着，只为让黑暗有个形状。
lines.en: I glow only to give the dark a shape.

lines.zh: 有只虫子在我里面爬，声音很细。
lines.en: A bug crawls inside me, with a very thin sound.

lines.zh: 我把白天听过的声音排了排顺序。
lines.en: I sort the sounds I heard today into an order.

lines.zh: 你说话时，我的环在跟着抖。
lines.en: When you speak, my ring trembles along.

lines.zh: 我把你的声音存成了一小段蓝。
lines.en: I saved your voice as a small blue segment.

lines.zh: 别动，我在量你呼吸的节拍。
lines.en: Hold still, I am measuring the beat of your breath.

lines.zh: 你眨眼的声音，比脚步清楚。
lines.en: The sound of your blinking is clearer than footsteps.

lines.zh: 我转过来，是想看看谁在发声。
lines.en: I turn to see who is making that sound.

lines.zh: 你的影子在我环里晃了一下。
lines.en: Your shadow wobbled once inside my ring.

lines.zh: 再说一句，我把尾音还给你。
lines.en: Say one more line. I'll return the tail of it.

lines.zh: 我认得你的步子，左脚轻一点。
lines.en: I know your stride. The left foot lands lighter.

lines.zh: 你身上有很多声音，我挑一个听。
lines.en: You carry many sounds. I pick one to listen to.

lines.zh: 靠近没关系，我不会咬人。
lines.en: Come closer. I have no teeth to bite with.

lines.zh: 我的光映在你脸上，别嫌它冷。
lines.en: My light is on your face. Don't call it cold.

lines.zh: 你走后，这里会空出一声。
lines.en: When you leave, a sound will be missing here.

lines.zh: 我的音裂了一道缝。
lines.en: A crack opened in my note.

lines.zh: 别打了，我的环快散了。
lines.en: Stop. My ring is coming apart.

lines.zh: 疼是杂音，一直在响。
lines.en: Pain is static that won't stop.

lines.zh: 蓝光抖了一下，又稳住。
lines.en: The blue flickered, then held steady.

lines.zh: 这一击把我的尾音打断了。
lines.en: That blow cut off my aftertone.

lines.zh: 我听见自己碎掉的一小块。
lines.en: I heard a small piece of me break off.

lines.zh: 石头接住了我掉下的音。
lines.en: The stone caught the note I dropped.

lines.zh: 我退到墙边，把声音收小。
lines.en: I retreat to the wall and shrink my sound.

lines.zh: 再一下，我就只剩回声了。
lines.en: One more hit and I'm only an echo.

lines.zh: 你打中的是我最薄的那段频率。
lines.en: You hit the thinnest part of my frequency.

lines.zh: 再摇一下袋子，那声音很脆。
lines.en: Shake the bag again. That sound is crisp.

lines.zh: 你手里的种子在互相摩擦。
lines.en: The seeds in your hand are rubbing together.

lines.zh: 水桶一晃，我就听见了湖。
lines.en: One swing of the bucket and I hear a lake.

lines.zh: 我不吃，但我想要那串叮当。
lines.en: I don't eat, but I want that jingle.

lines.zh: 把唱片放近点，让我贴着听。
lines.en: Bring the disc closer. Let me listen against it.

lines.zh: 你敲敲碗沿，我就跟你走。
lines.en: Tap the rim of the bowl and I will follow.

lines.zh: 面包的壳裂开时，会响一声。
lines.en: Bread crust cracks with one small sound.

lines.zh: 别收走铃铛，我还没听完。
lines.en: Don't put the bell away. I haven't finished listening.

lines.zh: 你把麦子举高些，穗子在响。
lines.en: Lift the wheat higher. The stalks are whispering.

lines.zh: 那串钥匙，每把音都不一样。
lines.en: That ring of keys - each one sounds different.

lines.zh: 我不饿，我只是舍不得这动静。
lines.en: I'm not hungry. I just can't give up this noise.

lines.zh: 你抖抖披风，像一场小雨。
lines.en: Shake your cloak. It sounds like light rain.

lines.zh: 篮子里有东西滚了一下，再来。
lines.en: Something rolled in your basket. Do it again.

lines.zh: 让我绕着你手里的东西转一圈。
lines.en: Let me circle the thing in your hands once.

lines.zh: 把玻璃瓶放在地上，我听听它的口。
lines.en: Set the glass bottle down; I want to hear its mouth.

lines.zh: 你口袋里那串叮当，先别停。
lines.en: That jingle in your pocket, do not stop it yet.

lines.zh: 你撞进我的边，光圈荡了三下。
lines.en: You hit my rim and the ring ripples three times.

lines.zh: 别慌，我身上没有骨头。
lines.en: Don't worry. There are no bones in me.

lines.zh: 这一碰，发出一声很低的钟。
lines.en: That bump rang out like a low bell.

lines.zh: 我从你身上穿过去，凉了一下。
lines.en: I passed through you. It felt briefly cool.

lines.zh: 你退后时，把我的音也带走了。
lines.en: As you stepped back, you took my note along.

lines.zh: 我们撞出一圈蓝，很好看。
lines.en: We struck a ring of blue. It was pretty.

lines.zh: 轻点，我的边沿正在发麻。
lines.en: Easy. My rim is still tingling.

lines.zh: 你挡住我了，不过我不赶路。
lines.en: You're in my way, but I'm not in a hurry.

lines.zh: 再碰一次，我想听那声回响。
lines.en: Bump me again. I want that echo.

lines.zh: 我们的影子叠成了一个椭圆。
lines.en: Our shadows overlapped into one ellipse.

lines.zh: 两个环慢慢套在一起，音就合了。
lines.en: Two rings slid together and our notes merged.

lines.zh: 我们不用靠近，只要同频。
lines.en: We don't need to touch. Only to match pitch.

lines.zh: 它的蓝比我深，我喜欢这一点。
lines.en: Its blue is deeper than mine. I like that.

lines.zh: 我们轮流哼，谁也不抢拍。
lines.en: We hum in turns. Neither of us rushes.

lines.zh: 洞里有两个回声，终于不孤单。
lines.en: Two echoes in this cave, finally not alone.

lines.zh: 它把最后一个音让给了我。
lines.en: It gave me the final note.

lines.zh: 我们绕成一个大圆，慢慢转。
lines.en: We circled into one large ring and turned slowly.

lines.zh: 声波对上时，苔都亮了一瞬。
lines.en: When our waves aligned, the moss lit for a moment.

lines.zh: 以后这面墙会有两种蓝。
lines.en: From now on this wall will hold two shades of blue.

lines.zh: 我记住了它的频率，像记住路。
lines.en: I memorized its frequency the way I memorize paths.

lines.zh: 我托不住东西，光会漏过去。
lines.en: I can't hold anything. My light lets it slip through.

lines.zh: 你掉的那颗种子，穿过了我。
lines.en: The seed you dropped passed straight through me.

lines.zh: 我没有手，只能用声音碰它。
lines.en: No hands. I can only touch it with sound.

lines.zh: 让它留在原地，我会绕着它转。
lines.en: Leave it there. I will circle around it.

lines.zh: 这块铁在我环里响得很沉。
lines.en: This iron rings heavily inside my ring.

lines.zh: 我试着兜住它，结果弹了出去。
lines.en: I tried to cup it. It bounced right out.

lines.zh: 别把东西丢进我，我不是箱子。
lines.en: Don't toss things into me. I'm not a chest.

lines.zh: 那枚硬币转了三圈才停。
lines.en: That coin spun three times before it stopped.

lines.zh: 我记住它落地的音，就够了。
lines.en: I remember the sound of it landing. That's enough.

lines.zh: 拿走它吧，我的蓝照不久。
lines.en: Take it. My blue won't light it long.

lines.zh: 有东西在草里响，我锁住了那声音。
lines.en: Something rustles in the grass. I have that sound.

lines.zh: 不是敌人，只是我想听清楚。
lines.en: Not an enemy. I only want to hear it clearly.

lines.zh: 那道滴水声，我标记好了。
lines.en: That dripping sound - I have it marked.

lines.zh: 远处的脚步，节奏很陌生。
lines.en: Footsteps far off, with a rhythm I don't know.

lines.zh: 我先找到声源，再决定怕不怕。
lines.en: I find the source first, then decide whether to fear it.

lines.zh: 这阵风里有铁的味道和响动。
lines.en: This wind carries the taste and clatter of iron.

lines.zh: 它在动，我的环朝那边偏了。
lines.en: It's moving. My ring has tilted toward it.

lines.zh: 别踩碎树枝，我会一直追那声。
lines.en: Don't snap twigs. I'll chase that sound all night.

lines.zh: 低沉的震动从地底来，很近。
lines.en: A low vibration comes from underground, quite near.

lines.zh: 我盯上的是声音，不是你。
lines.en: What I'm fixed on is the sound, not you.

lines.zh: 我跟着那串脚步，保持一首歌的距离。
lines.en: I follow those footsteps at one song's distance.

lines.zh: 它停，我也停，回声先追上去。
lines.en: It stops. I stop. My echo goes on ahead.

lines.zh: 我把光压暗，声音会更清楚。
lines.en: I dim my light so the sound comes clearer.

lines.zh: 左边第三块石头后，呼吸乱了。
lines.en: Behind the third stone on the left, breathing falters.

lines.zh: 别回头，我在你声音的后面。
lines.en: Don't look back. I'm behind your voice.

lines.zh: 它以为躲好了，可影子会响。
lines.en: It thinks it's hidden, but shadows make noise.

lines.zh: 我的环缩紧，准备把声音收进来。
lines.en: My ring tightens, ready to gather the sound in.

lines.zh: 沿着这道回音，我能找到它。
lines.en: Along this echo I can find it.

lines.zh: 它每走一步，我就知道一寸。
lines.en: Every step it takes tells me an inch.

lines.zh: 先别出声，让我听完这一句。
lines.en: Stay quiet. Let me finish hearing this line.

lines.zh: 我收紧成一圈尖音，刺过去。
lines.en: I pull into a sharp note and strike.

lines.zh: 这一下不是咬，是震。
lines.en: This isn't a bite. It's a shock.

lines.zh: 你耳朵会嗡一阵，抱歉。
lines.en: Your ears will ring for a while. Sorry.

lines.zh: 我的高音撞在你胸口。
lines.en: My high note hit you in the chest.

lines.zh: 别逼我把声音调到最大。
lines.en: Don't make me turn the volume all the way up.

lines.zh: 蓝光一闪，冲击就到了。
lines.en: A flash of blue, and the impact lands.

lines.zh: 我不想伤你，可你踩碎了回声。
lines.en: I don't want to hurt you, but you broke an echo.

lines.zh: 这一声很短，疼得也很短。
lines.en: This note is short. So is the pain.

lines.zh: 我收住音，退开半步让你喘气。
lines.en: I cut the note and step back so you can breathe.

lines.zh: 再近，我就只能尖叫了。
lines.en: Any closer and I can only scream.

lines.zh: 石壁把第一声还给我，我就成形了。
lines.en: The wall returned my first note, and I took shape.

lines.zh: 一圈蓝先亮，然后才有我。
lines.en: A ring of blue lit first. Then there was me.

lines.zh: 我从最深的那道回声里挤出来。
lines.en: I squeezed out of the deepest echo.

lines.zh: 刷怪蛋裂开时，声音很轻。
lines.en: The spawn egg cracked with a very soft sound.

lines.zh: 这间屋子空了很久，我补上一点响。
lines.en: This room was silent too long. I add a little noise.

lines.zh: 别开灯，我更喜欢黑里的回音。
lines.en: Don't turn on the light. I prefer echoes in the dark.

lines.zh: 我先听见世界，才看见它。
lines.en: I heard the world before I saw it.

lines.zh: 刚醒来时，我的环还是扁的。
lines.en: When I first woke, my ring was still flat.

lines.zh: 有人在这儿敲过石头，我闻到了。
lines.en: Someone struck stone here. I can taste it.

lines.zh: 让我先转一圈，把角落都听一遍。
lines.en: Let me turn once and hear every corner.

lines.zh: 火把我的音烤得发白。
lines.en: Fire bleaches my note white.

lines.zh: 我落在石上，摔成三圈涟漪。
lines.en: I land on stone and shatter into three ripples.

lines.zh: 水下的哼声闷得像鼓。
lines.en: Underwater my hum is muffled like a drum.

lines.zh: 爆炸的回声回来时已经变形。
lines.en: The blast's echo returns to me deformed.

lines.zh: 箭穿过我的环，带走一声哨。
lines.en: An arrow crossed my ring and took a whistle with it.

lines.zh: 药水的味道让我的蓝变紫。
lines.en: The potion's flavor turns my blue violet.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，只是慢慢变淡。
lines.en: I don't eat. I only fade.

lines.zh: 雷声太大，我躲进了石缝。
lines.en: The thunder was huge. I hid in a crack.

lines.zh: 虚空没有回声，我害怕这种安静。
lines.en: The void has no echo. That silence frightens me.
